title: StrictLocalCohomologyGerms
statement: For L in D⁺(Ab(S_et)) and n an integer, define the derived sections presheaf U↦Hom(Z[U][0],L[n]). Define its canonical cohomology germ map by applying degree-zero homology, evaluation at the free generator and the homology shift isomorphism. Restrict this functor to the small affine pointed neighbourhoods of a geometric point s [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Define the source legs as the presheaf germs followed by the stalk map of this canonical comparison and the unique strict-local germ restriction transported through exact-inverse-image homology. The latter restriction is an isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-strict-local-germ-restriction-iso].

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text: Use the adopted source definitions of the free abelian sheaf, generator evaluation, derived Hom comparison, shifted cohomology presheaf, germ map and small-neighbourhood functor. For the source comparison on strictLocalization, choose the uniquely characterized stalk restriction, use its invertibility, and compose with exact-inverse-image homology. Its source legs are the presheaf germs followed by this comparison; naturality is the stalk cocone equation. The separate small-coordinate-ring-colimit realization is not part of this attachment.

def strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) :
    strictLocalCohomologyNeighbourhoodFunctor s L n ⟶
      (Functor.const _).obj
        ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictLocalization s).smallEtaleTopology
          AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (Scheme.strictLocalizationToBase s)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj L)))
